```{r}
#| include: false
required_packages <- c("knitr", "DBI", "odbc", "plotly", "DT")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Brakuje pakietów R: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    ". Zainstaluj je poleceniem install.packages(c(",
    paste(sprintf('\"%s\"', missing_packages), collapse = ", "),
    ")).",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

connection <- DBI::dbConnect(
  odbc::odbc(),
  Driver = Sys.getenv("MSSQL_DRIVER", "ODBC Driver 18 for SQL Server"),
  Server = Sys.getenv("MSSQL_SERVER", "localhost\\SQLEXPRESS"),
  Database = Sys.getenv("MSSQL_DATABASE", "tomawebp_oferta"),
  Trusted_Connection = "Yes",
  Encrypt = "Yes",
  TrustServerCertificate = "Yes",
  timeout = 10
)

data <- tryCatch(
  {
    offer <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
      connection,
      paste(
        "SELECT id, ProductName, StockQty, UnitOfMeasure, VatRate,",
        "NetPrice, GrossPrice, StockStatus, PriceStatus, VatStatus,",
        "HasVatPriceMismatch, GrossPriceBand, GrossPriceBandSort,",
        "InferredProductGroup, StockValueNet, StockValueGross, CreatedAt",
        "FROM dbo.vw_Oferta_Analytics"
      )
    )

    issues <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
      connection,
      paste(
        "SELECT id, ProductName, StockQty, UnitOfMeasure, VatRate,",
        "NetPrice, GrossPrice, StockStatus, PriceStatus, VatStatus,",
        "GrossPriceDifference, DataQualityIssue",
        "FROM dbo.vw_Oferta_DataQualityIssues"
      )
    )

    history <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
      connection,
      paste(
        "SELECT h.OfertaId, h.DataStanu, h.Ilosc, o.nazwa AS ProductName,",
        "o.jm AS UnitOfMeasure FROM dbo.StanMagazynowyHistoria AS h",
        "INNER JOIN dbo.Oferta AS o ON o.id = h.OfertaId",
        "ORDER BY h.DataStanu, o.nazwa"
      )
    )

    list(offer = offer, issues = issues, history = history)
  },
  finally = DBI::dbDisconnect(connection)
)
offer <- data$offer
issues <- data$issues
history <- data$history

if (nrow(offer) == 0) {
  stop("Widok dbo.vw_Oferta_Analytics nie zawiera produktów.", call. = FALSE)
}

total_products <- nrow(offer)
products_with_stock <- sum(!is.na(offer$StockQty))
products_without_stock <- sum(offer$StockStatus == "No stock data", na.rm = TRUE)
total_gross_stock_value <- sum(offer$StockValueGross, na.rm = TRUE)
vat_mismatches <- sum(offer$HasVatPriceMismatch, na.rm = TRUE)
history_dates <- if (nrow(history)) length(unique(history$DataStanu)) else 0L
stocked <- offer[!is.na(offer$StockQty) & !is.na(offer$UnitOfMeasure), , drop = FALSE]
unit_summary <- stats::aggregate(StockQty ~ UnitOfMeasure, stocked, sum)
unit_counts <- table(stocked$UnitOfMeasure)
unit_summary$ProductCount <- as.integer(unit_counts[unit_summary$UnitOfMeasure])
unit_summary <- unit_summary[c("UnitOfMeasure", "ProductCount", "StockQty")]
names(unit_summary) <- c("Jednostka", "Produkty z ilością", "Łączna ilość")
pieces <- stocked[stocked$UnitOfMeasure == "szt", , drop = FALSE]
top_piece_stocks <- utils::head(pieces[order(pieces$StockQty, decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE], 12)
demo_source <- utils::head(pieces[order(pieces$StockQty, decreasing = TRUE), c("ProductName", "StockQty"), drop = FALSE], 4)
demo_date <- max(as.Date(offer$CreatedAt), na.rm = TRUE)
demo_dates <- rev(seq.Date(from = demo_date, by = "-1 month", length.out = 6))
demo_factors <- matrix(c(
  .83, .92, .89, 1.04, .96, 1,
  1.12, 1.05, .91, .95, 1.08, 1,
  .91, .80, .94, 1.06, .98, 1,
  1.07, .95, 1.11, .89, .93, 1
), nrow = 4, byrow = TRUE)
demo_history <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(demo_source)), function(i) {
  data.frame(Data = demo_dates, Produkt = demo_source$ProductName[i], Jednostka = "szt",
    Ilosc = round(demo_source$StockQty[i] * demo_factors[i, ]), Typ = "Symulacja", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
in_stock_count <- sum(offer$StockStatus == "In stock", na.rm = TRUE)
low_stock_count <- sum(offer$StockStatus == "Low stock", na.rm = TRUE)
missing_stock_count <- sum(offer$StockStatus == "No stock data", na.rm = TRUE)
other_group_count <- sum(offer$InferredProductGroup == "Other", na.rm = TRUE)
water_stock_value <- sum(offer$StockValueGross[offer$InferredProductGroup == "Water"], na.rm = TRUE)
median_gross_price <- stats::median(offer$GrossPrice, na.rm = TRUE)
format_count <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = " ", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
format_percent <- function(x, total = total_products) {
  paste0(format(round(100 * x / total, 1), big.mark = " ", decimal.mark = ",", nsmall = 1), "%")
}
format_pln <- function(x) {
  paste0(format(round(x, 0), big.mark = " ", decimal.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE), " zł")
}
format_pln_precise <- function(x) {
  paste0(format(round(x, 2), big.mark = " ", decimal.mark = ",", nsmall = 2, scientific = FALSE), " zł")
}

stock_order <- c(
  "In stock",
  "Low stock",
  "Out of stock",
  "No stock data",
  "Invalid stock"
)
stock_labels <- c(
  "In stock" = "Na stanie",
  "Low stock" = "Niski stan",
  "Out of stock" = "Brak na stanie",
  "No stock data" = "Brak danych",
  "Invalid stock" = "Nieprawidłowa wartość"
)
stock_colors <- c(
  "Na stanie" = "#198754",
  "Niski stan" = "#f0ad4e",
  "Brak na stanie" = "#dc3545",
  "Brak danych" = "#6c757d",
  "Nieprawidłowa wartość" = "#6610f2"
)
stock_counts <- as.data.frame(
  table(factor(offer$StockStatus, levels = stock_order), useNA = "no")
)
names(stock_counts) <- c("Status", "Liczba produktów")
stock_counts$Status <- unname(stock_labels[as.character(stock_counts$Status)])

group_names <- offer$InferredProductGroup
group_names[is.na(group_names) | group_names == ""] <- "Nieznana grupa"
stock_value_by_group <- stats::aggregate(
  offer$StockValueGross,
  by = list(Grupa = group_names),
  FUN = function(value) sum(value, na.rm = TRUE)
)
names(stock_value_by_group)[2] <- "Wartość brutto stanu (PLN)"
stock_value_by_group <- stock_value_by_group[
  order(stock_value_by_group[["Wartość brutto stanu (PLN)"]]),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
stock_value_by_group <- utils::tail(stock_value_by_group, 12)

price_bands <- unique(offer[c("GrossPriceBand", "GrossPriceBandSort")])
price_bands <- price_bands[
  order(price_bands$GrossPriceBandSort),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
price_band_counts <- as.data.frame(
  table(factor(offer$GrossPriceBand, levels = price_bands$GrossPriceBand))
)
names(price_band_counts) <- c("Przedział ceny brutto", "Liczba produktów")

missing_stock <- offer[
  !is.na(offer$StockStatus) & offer$StockStatus == "No stock data",
  c("id", "ProductName", "UnitOfMeasure", "NetPrice", "GrossPrice"),
  drop = FALSE
]
missing_stock <- missing_stock[
  order(missing_stock$ProductName, na.last = TRUE),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

lowest_stock <- offer[!is.na(offer$StockQty), , drop = FALSE]
lowest_stock <- lowest_stock[
  order(lowest_stock$StockQty, lowest_stock$ProductName, na.last = TRUE),
  c("id", "ProductName", "StockQty", "UnitOfMeasure", "GrossPrice", "StockStatus"),
  drop = FALSE
]
lowest_stock <- utils::head(lowest_stock, 100)
```

```{r}
stock_plot <- plotly::plot_ly(
  stock_counts,
  x = ~`Liczba produktów`,
  y = ~stats::reorder(Status, `Liczba produktów`),
  type = "bar",
  orientation = "h",
  marker = list(color = unname(stock_colors[as.character(stock_counts$Status)])),
  text = ~`Liczba produktów`,
  textposition = "outside",
  hovertemplate = "%{y}<br>%{x} produktów<extra></extra>"
)
plotly::layout(stock_plot,
  xaxis = list(title = NULL, rangemode = "tozero", gridcolor = "#e9eef5"),
  yaxis = list(title = NULL), showlegend = FALSE,
  margin = list(l = 125, r = 35, t = 20, b = 35),
  paper_bgcolor = "transparent", plot_bgcolor = "transparent"
)
```

```{r}
    htmltools::h3("Brak punktów historii"),
    htmltools::p("Historia SQL zawiera 0 zapisów. Strona „Historia” pokazuje osobną, wyraźnie oznaczoną symulację do demonstracji wykresu."),

  )

  htmltools::div(class = "history-empty",

  )
}
```

```{r}
    htmltools::p(htmltools::strong(paste0(format_count(in_stock_count), " produktów (", format_percent(in_stock_count), ")")),

      format_count(missing_stock_count), " produktów (", format_percent(missing_stock_count), "). Brak danych nie oznacza stanu zerowego.")
  ),
  htmltools::div(class = "insight-item",
    htmltools::div(class = "insight-label", "Wartość zapasu"),

      ". Woda odpowiada za około ", format_percent(water_stock_value, total_gross_stock_value), " tej wartości według grupy wywnioskowanej z nazwy produktu.")
  ),
  htmltools::div(class = "insight-item",
    htmltools::div(class = "insight-label", "Ceny i VAT"),
    htmltools::p("Mediana ceny brutto to ", htmltools::strong(format_pln_precise(median_gross_price)),
      ". Niezgodność ceny brutto z wyliczeniem VAT wykryto w ", format_count(vat_mismatches), " produktach (",
      format_percent(vat_mismatches), ").")
  ),
  htmltools::div(class = "insight-item insight-caveat",
    htmltools::div(class = "insight-label", "Ograniczenia interpretacji"),
    htmltools::p("Grupa „Inne” obejmuje ", format_count(other_group_count), " produktów (", format_percent(other_group_count),
      "), więc podział kategorii jest mało precyzyjny. Historia SQL jest pusta — nie można ocenić rzeczywistych zmian zapasu. Strona „Historia” zawiera wyłącznie symulację. Jednostki produktów są różne, dlatego niski stan należy czytać zgodnie z jednostką produktu.")
  )
)
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: Szczegóły kontroli
if (nrow(issues) == 0) {
  htmltools::p("Nie znaleziono pozycji wymagających uwagi.")
} else {
  issues <- issues[order(issues$DataQualityIssue, issues$ProductName, issues$id, na.last = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
  issues$StockStatus <- unname(stock_labels[as.character(issues$StockStatus)])
  issue_code <- as.character(issues$DataQualityIssue)
  issue_area <- ifelse(issue_code %in% c("Missing product name", "Duplicate name"), "Product",
    ifelse(grepl("VAT", issue_code, ignore.case = TRUE), "VAT",
      ifelse(grepl("price", issue_code, ignore.case = TRUE), "Price", "Stock")))
  issues$DataQualityArea <- unname(c(Product = "Produkt", Price = "Cena", VAT = "VAT", Stock = "Magazyn")[issue_area])
  issues$DataQualityIssue <- unname(c(
    "Missing product name" = "Brak nazwy produktu", "Missing price" = "Brak ceny",
    "Invalid price" = "Nieprawidłowa cena", "Invalid VAT" = "Nieprawidłowy VAT",
    "Unusual VAT" = "Nietypowa stawka VAT",
    "Gross price differs from net price + VAT" = "Cena brutto różni się od netto + VAT",
    "No stock data" = "Brak danych o stanie", "Out of stock" = "Brak na stanie",
    "Invalid stock" = "Nieprawidłowy stan", "Duplicate name" = "Duplikat produktu"
  )[issue_code])
  names(issues) <- c("ID", "Produkt", "Stan", "Jednostka", "VAT (%)", "Netto (zł)", "Brutto (zł)",
    "Dostępność", "Status ceny", "Status VAT", "Różnica brutto (zł)", "Problem", "Obszar")
  DT::datatable(issues, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
    options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE, autoWidth = FALSE))
}
```

```{r}
demo_plot <- plotly::plot_ly()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(demo_source))) {
  demo_plot <- plotly::add_trace(demo_plot,
    x = demo_dates,
    y = round(demo_source$StockQty[i] * demo_factors[i, ]),
    type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
    name = demo_source$ProductName[i],
    hovertemplate = "%{x|%m.%Y}<br>%{y:,.0f} szt.<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>"
  )
}
plotly::layout(demo_plot,
  xaxis = list(title = "Miesiąc", tickformat = "%b %Y"),
  yaxis = list(title = "Ilość (szt.)", rangemode = "tozero", tickformat = ",.0f", gridcolor = "#e9eef5"),
  hovermode = "x unified", legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2),
  paper_bgcolor = "transparent", plot_bgcolor = "transparent"
)
```
